questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: Do not use 'would' in the if-clause. Use the past simple: if I had.
questions.wrong: If I would have more time, I would learn Spanish.
solutions: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.

questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: 'Suggest' is not followed by an object + to-infinitive. Use 'suggested that I take' or 'suggested taking'.
questions.wrong: She suggested me to take a taxi.
solutions: She suggested that I take a taxi.
She suggested that I should take a taxi.
She suggested I take a taxi.
